name: Pneumatic Front End Loader
instructions: omr/instructions/8464-1-1.pdf (the loader is pages 4-49; the alternate grab model is pages 50-89, and pages 90-98 add a motor to the loader)

functions.does: The steering wheel in the cab steers the loader by bending it in the middle: an 8-tooth pinion at the foot of its column runs on a 40-tooth gear lying flat on the joint between the two frames, so the front frame, with its wheels, boom and bucket, swings left and right against the rear about a vertical pivot.
functions.source: book: step 13 (page 15, the two frames joined), step 19 (page 20, the 40-tooth gear), cab steps 1-8 (pages 25-26), step 26 (page 27, the cab lowered with its pinion onto the 40-tooth gear); inferred: which frame the 40-tooth gear is fixed to

functions.does: The round yellow knob on top of the tall shaft behind the cab steers too: the shaft's 8-tooth gear turns a 16-tooth gear on the 40-tooth gear at the joint, and the steering wheel turns along with it.
functions.source: book: step 20 (page 20), step 25 (page 24, the tall shaft), step 41 (page 45, the knob)

functions.does: Pushing the loader along turns all four wheels together and runs the V6 engine: each axle's differential turns a 16-tooth gear on a cross shaft, which drives a 24-tooth crown gear on the drive shaft; the drive shaft runs through a universal joint under the pivot to join the two axles, and an 8-tooth gear on the crankshaft runs off the rear crown gear, so the six pistons go up and down.
functions.source: book: steps 3-5 (page 5, rear differential and crown gear), front axle steps 1-11 (pages 10-11), step 12 (page 9, universal joint), step 13 (page 15), engine steps 1-7 (pages 38-39) and step 37 (page 40)

functions.does: The rear differential lets the rear wheels turn at different speeds in a bend: with the drive held, turning one rear wheel turns the other the opposite way.
functions.source: book: steps 3-5 (page 5); inferred: what it's for

functions.does: The front differential does the same for the front wheels.
functions.source: book: front axle steps 1-11 (pages 10-11); inferred: what it's for

functions.does: Pushing the pump's black knob in and out 30-35 times fills the blue air tank.
functions.source: book: step 35 (page 36, the pump), step 39 (page 42, the tank), page 48 (30-35 strokes)

functions.does: One valve raises and lowers the boom: it feeds the two cylinders low down between the front wheels, which push the boom up about its pivot at the top of the black uprights; the bucket rises and falls with it.
functions.source: book: lift cylinders step 24 (page 23), boom steps 21-23 (pages 21-23), valves steps 33-34 (pages 34-35), finished model page 48; inferred: which of the model's two valves is which

functions.does: The other valve tips the bucket: it feeds the cylinder on top of the boom, which turns the bucket on the end of the boom through a lever and two links.
functions.source: book: tilt cylinder step 18 (page 19), boom step 22 (page 22), valves steps 33-34 (pages 34-35), bucket step 43 (page 47), finished model page 48; inferred: which of the model's two valves is which
